from itertools import product
from fractions import Fraction

r=q=3
rect=(2,2)

def norm(p):
    return tuple(x for x in p if x)
def contains(nu,mu):
    return len(nu)>=len(mu) and all(nu[i]>=mu[i] for i in range(len(mu)))
def size(p): return sum(p)
def lab(p): return ''.join(map(str,p)) if p else '0'
def parts_box(r,q):
    out=[]
    def rec(prev, left, cur):
        out.append(tuple(cur))
        if len(cur)==r: return
        for x in range(min(prev,left),0,-1): rec(x,x,cur+[x])
    # direct enumeration of weakly decreasing rows, retaining positive rows
    def go(prev, cur):
        out.append(tuple(cur))
        if len(cur)==r: return
        for x in range(min(prev,q),0,-1): go(x,cur+[x])
    out=[]; go(q,[])
    return sorted(set(out), key=lambda x:(size(x),x))

B=parts_box(r,q)
J=[p for p in B if contains(p,rect)]
J=sorted(J,key=lambda x:(size(x),x))
idx={p:i for i,p in enumerate(J)}
print('J columns:', [lab(x) for x in J])

# Independent Pieri enumerator: nu/mu has k cells and no repeated column.
def horizontal(mu,nu,k):
    if not contains(nu,mu) or size(nu)-size(mu)!=k: return False
    cols=[]
    for a in range(len(nu)):
        old=mu[a] if a<len(mu) else 0
        cols += list(range(old+1,nu[a]+1))
    return len(cols)==k and len(set(cols))==k

def pieri_row(mu,k):
    v=[0]*len(J)
    for nu in J:
        if horizontal(mu,nu,k): v[idx[nu]]+=1
    return v
P=[]
for mu in J:
    for k in range(1,q+1):
        v=pieri_row(mu,k)
        if any(v): P.append((size(mu)+k,lab(mu)+';h'+str(k),v))
P.sort()
print('Pieri nonzero rows (%d):'%len(P))
for d,s,v in P: print(d,s,[(lab(J[t]),x) for t,x in enumerate(v) if x])

# Direct LR tableau enumerator. Fill reading word: each row right-to-left, rows top-to-bottom.
def lr_coeff(lam,mu,nu):
    if size(lam)+size(mu)!=size(nu) or not contains(nu,lam): return 0
    cells=[]
    for a in range(len(nu)):
        lo=lam[a] if a<len(lam) else 0
        for c in range(nu[a],lo,-1): cells.append((a,c))
    m=len(mu); target=[0]+list(mu); used=[0]*(m+1); fill={}; count=0
    def rec(t):
        nonlocal count
        if t==len(cells): count+=1; return
        a,c=cells[t]
        right=fill.get((a,c+1))
        above=fill.get((a-1,c))
        for x in range(1,m+1):
            if used[x]>=target[x]: continue
            # semistandard: row weak left-to-right; column strict top-to-bottom
            if right is not None and x>right: continue
            if above is not None and x<=above: continue
            used[x]+=1
            # lattice/Yamanouchi condition for each prefix
            good=all(used[z]>=used[z+1] for z in range(1,m))
            if good:
                fill[(a,c)]=x; rec(t+1); del fill[(a,c)]
            used[x]-=1
    rec(0)
    return count

def lr_row(lam,mu):
    v=[0]*len(J)
    for nu in J:
        c=lr_coeff(lam,mu,nu)
        if c: v[idx[nu]]=c
    return v
L=[]
for lam in B:
    if not lam: continue
    for mu in J:
        v=lr_row(lam,mu)
        if any(v): L.append((size(lam)+size(mu),lab(lam)+';'+lab(mu),v))
L.sort()
print('LR nonzero rows (%d):'%len(L))
# Check direct LR agrees with Pieri on every h_k=s_(k).
for d,s,v in P:
    mu=tuple(map(int,s.split(';')[0])); k=int(s.split('h')[1])
    assert v==lr_row((k,),mu), ('Pieri/LR mismatch',s)
print('Pieri equals direct-LR for all %d Pieri rows.'%len(P))

# Fixed certificate: F1=(22,32,33); C is every other column, selected rows as listed.
F=[(2,2),(3,2),(3,3)]
C=[p for p in J if p not in F]
selkeys=[('22;h1'),('32;h1'),('22;h2'),('33;h1'),('222;h1'),('331;h1'),('332;h1')]
byname={s:v for d,s,v in P}
R=[byname[x] for x in selkeys]
ci=[idx[p] for p in C]
M=[[v[t] for t in ci] for v in R]
print('free F1:',[lab(p) for p in F])
print('complement C:',[lab(p) for p in C])
print('selected rows:',selkeys)
print('certificate minor M=',M)

def det(A):
    A=[[Fraction(x) for x in row] for row in A]; n=len(A); ans=Fraction(1)
    for c in range(n):
        z=next((u for u in range(c,n) if A[u][c]),None)
        if z is None:return 0
        if z!=c:A[c],A[z]=A[z],A[c]; ans=-ans
        piv=A[c][c]; ans*=piv
        for u in range(c+1,n):
            if A[u][c]:
                fac=A[u][c]/piv
                for w in range(c,n):A[u][w]-=fac*A[c][w]
    assert ans.denominator==1
    return ans.numerator
D=det(M); print('det(M)=',D); assert abs(D)==1

# Coordinates x with x*R=v, obtained from complement coordinates x*M=v_C.
def coords(v):
    n=len(M); A=[[Fraction(M[i][j]) for i in range(n)]+[Fraction(v[ci[i])] for i in range(n)] for j in range(n)]
    # Solve transpose(M) x_col = v_C_col
    for c in range(n):
        z=next(u for u in range(c,n) if A[u][c])
        A[c],A[z]=A[z],A[c]
        piv=A[c][c]
        A[c]=[x/piv for x in A[c]]
        for u in range(n):
            if u!=c and A[u][c]:
                fac=A[u][c]; A[u]=[A[u][w]-fac*A[c][w] for w in range(n+1)]
    x=[A[i][-1] for i in range(n)]
    assert all(z.denominator==1 for z in x)
    x=[int(z) for z in x]
    rec=[sum(x[a]*R[a][b] for a in range(n)) for b in range(len(J))]
    assert rec==v
    return x

print('ALL PIERI REDUCTIONS (coordinates in selected-row order):')
for d,s,v in P: print(d,s,coords(v))
print('ALL LR REDUCTIONS (coordinates in selected-row order):')
for d,s,v in L: print(d,s,coords(v))
print('All %d LR rows and all %d Pieri rows reduce integrally.'%(len(L),len(P)))
print('Because selected Pieri rows are among LR rows and every LR/Pieri row has integral selected-row coordinates, both relation lattices equal Z-span(selected rows).')
print('Exact Smith invariants (Pieri and LR presentations): diag(1^7,0^3).')
